question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Mound
solution:
The correct answer is **"Valley."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **"mound"** is a raised area of land while a valley is a low area between hills or mountains. (मिट्टी या पत्‍थरों का टीला; एक छोटी पहाड़ी)

 
 
• **Example**: *We’re using that **mound**__ of sand to level the ground for our new pool.*
 
 
 
• Antonym of **Mound** is **Valley**.
 
• **"Valley"** means the low land between two mountains or hills, which often has a river flowing through it. (दो पर्वतों या पहाड़ों के बीच की नीची भूमि प्रायः जिससे होकर नदी बहती है; घाटी, वादी)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The river flowed through the **valley**__ below.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Prominence** means the state of being important or famous. (प्रमुखता)
 
• **Option 2: Victory** means the state of winning or triumphing over an opponent. (युद्घ, खेल, स्‍पर्धा आदि में सफलता, विजय, जीत, फ़तह)
 
• **Option 3: Bell** is a musical instrument or a device that produces a ringing sound. (प्याले के आकार की धातु की वस्तु जिस पर प्रहार करने पर घंटी जैसी आवाज़ निकलती है; घंटा, घंटी)
